job.job_description:
Greetings!

Experience: 4-7 years overall with 2-3 years in GenAI/LLM-based application development.
Work Location: Bangalore
Work Mode: Hybrid
Interview Process: Online Assessment/Test L1 Technical L2 Technical (Face-to-Face)
Mandatory Skills: Python, GenAI, LLMs (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI), RAG, Prompt Engineering, LangChain/LangGraph/Semantic Kernel/CrewAI, Vector Databases.
Experience building AI Agents, Copilots, and Agentic Workflows with tool calling and reasoning capabilities.
Hands-on experience with Azure/AWS/GCP, APIs, Git, and Docker.
